POST /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchan.title: Upload a KYC document
POST /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchan.description: Upload a KYC/identity document (ID, business registration, proof of address) for a merchant's onboarding. Pass the merchantId and the document; submit required documents before calling onboarding/complete.

POST /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchan.title: Extract onboarding data
POST /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchan.description: Auto-extract onboarding details from the merchant's website or uploaded documents to pre-fill their profile. Pass the merchantId; review the extracted fields before completing onboarding.

GET /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchant.title: Get onboarding status
GET /provisioning/v1/merchants/{merchant.description: Return the merchant's onboarding progress plus KYC and verification state. Poll this to see what remains before calling onboarding/complete.
